text:
toni: Noticed the KB search is returning the old runtime/caching.md link that 410s. Customer support just hit it from the KB and escalated.

toni: Quick reproduction: search for "kv cache 404" -> top result is /docs/runtime/caching (archived) -> 410.

rachel: Ugh. That page was migrated last quarter and we should have had redirects. Who owns runtime docs right now?

toni: I don't think there's an active owner on the frontmatter. Could be the old infra-docs team.

omar: I can take a look. If it's an expected redirect we should add a frontmatter `aliases:` entry or a permanent redirect rule in the site config. If the content was intentionally removed we should update the search index to exclude it.

infra-qa: FYI the staging link shows 200 for the new path (/docs/runtime/caching-v2) but production still indexes the old slug. Sounds like an indexing/redirect lag.

toni: Short-term plan: (1) add a temporary banner on the new page pointing to the canonical caching guide, (2) add aliases for the old slug in frontmatter, (3) open a small redirect mapping PR for the site config so support links don't 410.

rachel: Omar — can you own the PR? I can help test staging and then poke search reindex.

omar: Yep, I'll open a micro-PR. Steps: clone docs, add `aliases: ["/docs/runtime/caching"]` to caching-v2 frontmatter, add `redirects` entry in site/_redirects.yml, run `yarn docs:build` locally to sanity-check.

omar: I'll also add a one-line note in the caching-v2 top that says "migrated from /docs/runtime/caching — contact @rachel for content questions" so folks know who to ping.

rachel: Sound good. Can you also add a small check in CI with `linkinator` that fails on 4xx for pages in /docs/runtime/*? We had this regress before.

omar: I can add a follow-up issue for CI smoke checks. For this PR I want to keep scope tiny so we can ship the redirect quickly.

doc-bot: Opened issue #4789: "KB: search returns archived runtime/caching -> 410; add aliases + redirect" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4789 :white_check_mark:

toni: Thanks! Omar please @me in the PR so I can test with support repro steps.

infra-qa: After PR lands, I'll trigger a manual reindex of the search service and confirm the stale result disappears.

rachel: If anyone's blocked on access to the repo or redirect config ping me and I'll escalate with infra.

omar: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3245 — small frontmatter + redirect. Testing now in staging.

toni: Verified staging -> redirect works and search shows new result after manual reindex. Thanks team.

rachel: Sweet — closing the loop. I'll follow up to add a CI ticket for link checks in the next squad planning.
